title: Counter Staffed Minutes
description:
## Task

A cafe counter is staffed by several people whose shifts may overlap. Each shift is a half-open range of minutes `[start, end)`. Return how many distinct minutes have at least one person at the counter.

## Input

- `shifts` — a list of `[start, end]` pairs with `start < end`, in any order. It may be empty.

## Output

The number of minutes covered by at least one shift (an integer).

## Example

```python
staffed_minutes([[0, 60], [30, 90], [120, 150]])  # returns 120
staffed_minutes([[10, 20], [20, 30]])  # returns 20
staffed_minutes([[0, 100], [10, 20]])  # returns 100
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ number of shifts ≤ 10^4
- 0 ≤ `start` < `end` ≤ 10^9
